name: Qalat Village
description: Mountain village in a dry Afghan valley: the wadi and its tank wreck, a bazaar lane, a walled qala (A), a caravanserai (B) and the malik's compound.

briefing.attack: Come up the dry wadi past the old T-55 and plant the charge in the qala or the caravanserai.
briefing.defend: Hold the malik's compound and rotate through the orchard (A) or the threshing yard (B).
briefing.A: The qala: a walled mud fort with four round towers, a south gate, an east door, a north door and a weak patched wall to blow.
briefing.B: The caravanserai: a courtyard behind a tall iwan gate, domed rooms on the north side with a roof you can climb to.

duel._comment: 1v1 duels: site A only (the qala); a player-clip wall along x = 6.5 closes the east half (bazaar east side, B).
